segments.text: Cleopatra lived around the time the pyramids were built. Well, that's not exactly true. She lived closer to the iPhone than to the pyramids.
The Great Pyramid was finished around {2560 BC.|twenty five sixty B C.}
Cleopatra was born about two and a half thousand years later. To her, the pyramids were already ancient ruins.
And from Cleopatra to the first iPhone in {2007,|two thousand seven,} it's only about two thousand years. A shorter gap.
Here's the wild part. When the pyramids were being built, woolly mammoths were still alive, on a remote island in the Arctic.
In fact, Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire. Students were studying there before the Aztecs founded their capital city.
